briefs.coreQuestion: How do you verify that disabling the master email preference suppresses digest and alert delivery even when child toggles remain true?

outline.heading: Email master toggle delivery tests: What Must the Suite Prove?
outline.purpose: Answer "How do you verify that disabling the master email preference suppresses digest and alert delivery even when child toggles remain true?" in 40 to 60 words, define the contract as the master email switch must suppress digest and new-skill delivery even when either child preference remains enabled, and state the observable pass criteria.

outline.heading: Which QASkills Code Paths Own This Contract?
outline.purpose: Trace request, helper, schema, component, and persistence ownership only through packages/web/src/app/api/cron/weekly-digest/route.ts:subscriber where clause; packages/web/src/app/api/skills/route.ts:new skill alert subscriber where clause; packages/web/src/app/dashboard/preferences/page.tsx:master and child switches. Separate code-backed behavior from source-backed recommendations.

outline.purpose: Explain the normal path and compatibility boundaries for email master opt out test. Convert repository branches into named fixtures with complete observable outputs.

outline.heading: How Should New skill alert opt out Be Exercised?

outline.heading: Step-by-Step Parent child preference testing Procedure
outline.purpose: Present the numbered procedure for parent child preference testing: Seed one user for every parent-child preference combination. Run the digest subscriber query and skill-alert subscriber query against the same fixture set. Capture send attempts and assert delivery only for rows allowed by both master and child settings. Toggle the controls through the preferences UI and rerun the delivery matrix.

outline.heading: Notification delivery matrix: Assertions and Diagnostics
outline.purpose: Cover notification delivery matrix with status, state, side-effect, call-count, and visible-output assertions. Explain the failure signal a CI report must retain.

outline.heading: What Regressions and Boundaries Prevent False Confidence?
outline.purpose: UI disabled styling is not delivery proof; the database predicates and send calls remain the source of truth for suppression. List nearby concerns owned by related articles and define the post-change cases that remain in scope.

outline.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
outline.purpose: Answer five to eight questions in 40 to 60 words each. Cover "How do you verify that disabling the master email preference suppresses digest and alert delivery even when child toggles remain true?" plus question variants based on email master opt out test, weekly digest preference filter, new skill alert opt out, parent child preference testing, notification delivery matrix.

outline.heading: Conclusion
outline.purpose: Summarize the verified contract without introducing new claims, then use this CTA: Review the notification controls and add all parent-child combinations to the delivery regression suite.
